name: emr
description: Amazon EMR is a web service that makes it easier to process large amounts of data efficiently.

subcommands.name: add-instance-fleet
subcommands.description: Adds an instance fleet to a running cluster.

subcommands.name: add-instance-groups
subcommands.description: Adds an instance group to a running cluster.

subcommands.name: add-steps
subcommands.description: Add a list of steps to a cluster.

subcommands.name: add-tags
subcommands.description: Adds tags to an Amazon EMR resource, such as a cluster or an Amazon EMR Studio.

subcommands.name: cancel-steps
subcommands.description: Cancels a pending step or steps in a running cluster.

subcommands.name: create-cluster
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon EMR cluster with the specified configurations.

subcommands.name: create-default-roles
subcommands.description: Creates the default IAM role EMR_EC2_DefaultRole and EMR_DefaultRole which can be used when creating the cluster using the create-cluster command.

subcommands.name: create-hbase-backup
subcommands.description: Creates a HBase backup in S3.

subcommands.name: create-persistent-app-ui
subcommands.description: Creates a persistent application user interface.

subcommands.name: create-security-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates a security configuration, which is stored in the service and can be specified when a cluster is created.

subcommands.name: create-studio
subcommands.description: Creates a new Amazon EMR Studio.

subcommands.name: create-studio-session-mapping
subcommands.description: Maps a user or group to the Amazon EMR Studio specified by StudioId, and applies a session policy to refine Studio permissions for that user or group.

subcommands.name: delete-security-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes a security configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-studio
subcommands.description: Removes an Amazon EMR Studio from the Studio metadata store.

subcommands.name: delete-studio-session-mapping
subcommands.description: Removes a user or group from an Amazon EMR Studio.

subcommands.name: describe-cluster
subcommands.description: Provides cluster-level details including status, hardware and software configuration, VPC settings, bootstrap actions, instance groups and so on.

subcommands.name: describe-notebook-execution
subcommands.description: Provides details of a notebook execution.

subcommands.name: describe-persistent-app-ui
subcommands.description: Describes a persistent application user interface.

subcommands.name: describe-release-label
subcommands.description: Provides Amazon EMR release label details, such as the releases available the Region where the API request is run, and the available applications for a specific Amazon EMR release label.

subcommands.name: describe-security-configuration
subcommands.description: Provides the details of a security configuration by returning the configuration JSON.

subcommands.name: describe-step
subcommands.description: Provides more detail about the cluster step.

subcommands.name: describe-studio
subcommands.description: Returns details for the specified Amazon EMR Studio including ID, Name, VPC, Studio access URL, and so on.

subcommands.name: disable-hbase-backups
subcommands.description: Add a step to disable automated HBase backups.

subcommands.name: get
subcommands.description: Get file from master node.

subcommands.name: get-auto-termination-policy
subcommands.description: Returns the auto-termination policy for an Amazon EMR cluster.

subcommands.name: get-block-public-access-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns the Amazon EMR block public access configuration for your Amazon Web Services account in the current Region.

subcommands.name: get-cluster-session-credentials
subcommands.description: Provides temporary, HTTP basic credentials that are associated with a given runtime IAM role and used by a cluster with fine-grained access control activated.

subcommands.name: get-managed-scaling-policy
subcommands.description: Fetches the attached managed scaling policy for an Amazon EMR cluster.

subcommands.name: get-on-cluster-app-ui-presigned-url
subcommands.description: The presigned URL properties for the cluster's application user interface.

subcommands.name: get-persistent-app-ui-presigned-url
subcommands.description: The presigned URL properties for the cluster's application user interface.

subcommands.name: get-session
subcommands.description: Returns detailed information about a session.

subcommands.name: get-session-endpoint
subcommands.description: Returns the Spark Connect endpoint URL and a time-limited authentication token for the specified session.

subcommands.name: get-studio-session-mapping
subcommands.description: Fetches mapping details for the specified Amazon EMR Studio and identity (user or group).

subcommands.name: install-applications
subcommands.description: Installs applications on a running cluster.

subcommands.name: list-clusters
subcommands.description: Provides the status of all clusters visible to this Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-instance-fleets
subcommands.description: Lists all available details about the instance fleets in a cluster.

subcommands.name: list-instances
subcommands.description: Provides information for all active Amazon EC2 instances and Amazon EC2 instances terminated in the last 30 days, up to a maximum of 2,000.

subcommands.name: list-notebook-executions
subcommands.description: Provides summaries of all notebook executions.

subcommands.name: list-release-labels
subcommands.description: Retrieves release labels of Amazon EMR services in the Region where the API is called.

subcommands.name: list-security-configurations
subcommands.description: Lists all the security configurations visible to this account, providing their creation dates and times, and their names.

subcommands.name: list-sessions
subcommands.description: Lists the sessions on a cluster.

subcommands.name: list-steps
subcommands.description: Provides a list of steps for the cluster in reverse order unless you specify stepIds with the request or filter by StepStates.

subcommands.name: list-studio-session-mappings
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all user or group session mappings for the Amazon EMR Studio specified by StudioId.

subcommands.name: list-studios
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all Amazon EMR Studios associated with the Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-supported-instance-types
subcommands.description: A list of the instance types that Amazon EMR supports.

subcommands.name: modify-cluster
subcommands.description: Modifies the number of steps that can be executed concurrently for the cluster specified using ClusterID.

subcommands.name: modify-cluster-attributes
subcommands.description: Modifies the cluster attributes 'visible-to-all-users', 'termination-protected' and 'unhealthy-node-replacement'.

subcommands.name: modify-instance-fleet
subcommands.description: Modifies the target On-Demand and target Spot capacities for the instance fleet with the specified InstanceFleetID within the cluster specified using ClusterID.

subcommands.name: modify-instance-groups
subcommands.description: ModifyInstanceGroups modifies the number of nodes and configuration settings of an instance group.

subcommands.name: put
subcommands.description: Put file onto the master node.

subcommands.name: put-auto-scaling-policy
subcommands.description: Creates or updates an automatic scaling policy for a core instance group or task instance group in an Amazon EMR cluster.

subcommands.name: put-auto-termination-policy
subcommands.description: Auto-termination is supported in Amazon EMR releases 5.30.0 and 6.1.0 and later.

subcommands.name: put-block-public-access-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates or updates an Amazon EMR block public access configuration for your Amazon Web Services account in the current Region.

subcommands.name: put-managed-scaling-policy
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a managed scaling policy for an Amazon EMR cluster.

subcommands.name: remove-auto-scaling-policy
subcommands.description: Removes an automatic scaling policy from a specified instance group within an Amazon EMR cluster.

subcommands.name: remove-auto-termination-policy
subcommands.description: Removes an auto-termination policy from an Amazon EMR cluster.

subcommands.name: remove-managed-scaling-policy
subcommands.description: Removes a managed scaling policy from a specified Amazon EMR cluster.

subcommands.name: remove-tags
subcommands.description: Removes tags from an Amazon EMR resource, such as a cluster or Amazon EMR Studio.

subcommands.name: restore-from-hbase-backup
subcommands.description: Restores HBase from S3.

subcommands.name: schedule-hbase-backup
subcommands.description: Adds a step to schedule automated HBase backup.

subcommands.name: socks
subcommands.description: Create a socks tunnel on port 8157 from your machine to the master.

subcommands.name: ssh
subcommands.description: SSH into master node of the cluster.

subcommands.name: start-notebook-execution
subcommands.description: Starts a notebook execution.

subcommands.name: start-session
subcommands.description: Creates and starts a new Spark Connect session on the specified cluster.

subcommands.name: stop-notebook-execution
subcommands.description: Stops a notebook execution.

subcommands.name: terminate-clusters
subcommands.description: Shuts down one or more clusters, each specified by cluster ID.

subcommands.name: terminate-session
subcommands.description: Terminates an active session.

subcommands.name: update-studio
subcommands.description: Updates an Amazon EMR Studio configuration, including attributes such as name, description, and subnets.

subcommands.name: update-studio-session-mapping
subcommands.description: Updates the session policy attached to the user or group for the specified Amazon EMR Studio.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: cluster-running
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query Cluster.Status.State returns RUNNING when polling with ``describe-cluster``.

subcommands.name: cluster-terminated
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query Cluster.Status.State returns TERMINATED when polling with ``describe-cluster``.

subcommands.name: step-complete
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query Step.Status.State returns COMPLETED when polling with ``describe-step``.
